name: Virag 3D Creative Library
description: Dedicated still-image CGI and 3D advertising presets with direct image execution. Independent from generic Creative and Video libraries.
executionRule: DIRECT IMAGE EXECUTION: Generate the image now using the available image-generation capability. Do not reply with a prompt, concept explanation, plan, storyboard, or text-only description. Produce exactly one standalone still image for one preset unless the current user explicitly requests multiple outputs.

commands.label: 3D Product Hero
commands.desc: Premium CGI hero composition built around the exact uploaded subject
commands.prompt: DIRECT IMAGE EXECUTION: Generate the final image now, not a description. Create a premium high-end 3D hero creative using the current uploaded subject/product as the exact visual reference. Build one strong commercial composition with believable scale, contact shadows, premium materials, cinematic lighting, controlled depth, and a memorable advertising focal point. Preserve visible geometry, label/logo/artwork, colors, proportions, identity, and distinguishing details exactly.

commands.label: 3D Product Universe
commands.desc: Immersive brand-specific CGI world surrounding the subject
commands.prompt: DIRECT IMAGE EXECUTION: Generate the final image now, not a description. Create an immersive 3D universe around the exact current subject. Translate visible brand/category cues into architecture, materials, atmosphere, props, scale, and spatial storytelling without redesigning the subject. Use clear foreground, midground, and background depth and make the supplied subject the unmistakable hero.

commands.label: Anamorphic 3D OOH
commands.desc: Forced-perspective 3D billboard illusion with dramatic depth
commands.prompt: DIRECT IMAGE EXECUTION: Generate the final image now, not a description. Create a premium anamorphic 3D OOH creative where the current subject appears to break beyond a display plane through controlled forced perspective. Preserve the subject exactly, maintain believable depth, lighting and shadows, and design the illusion for one strong viewing angle. Produce one finished image, not a billboard-planning document.

commands.label: Chrome Sculpture
commands.desc: Reflective chrome-led 3D campaign world
commands.prompt: DIRECT IMAGE EXECUTION: Generate the final image now, not a description. Create a sophisticated chrome-led 3D advertising scene around the exact current subject. Use reflective sculptural forms, controlled specular highlights, premium studio lighting, and deliberate negative space. Keep chrome as the surrounding campaign language; do not chrome-coat or redesign the locked subject.

commands.label: Glass Sculpture

Create a premium refractive-glass 3D world around the exact subject using transparent sculptural forms, realistic refraction, optical lighting, subtle caustic behavior and strong depth. Preserve the subject exactly and keep glass effects in the environment rather than distorting it.

commands.label: Liquid Sculpture

Use one controlled fluid gesture with believable viscosity, splash shape, droplets, contact and lighting. Match the liquid behavior to the category where appropriate while preserving the supplied subject and avoiding chaotic generic splashes.

commands.label: 3D Exploded View

commands.prompt: DIRECT IMAGE EXECUTION: Generate the final image now, not a description. Create a premium 3D exploded-view creative only from visible or supplied components. Separate supported parts cleanly along a logical axis, preserve geometry and materials, and use technical-commercial lighting. Never invent hidden internals, ingredients, mechanisms, or components.

Never fabricate hidden internals or functional claims.

Keep source geometry and branding accurate and use physically believable micro-detail and lighting.
